description: A sixteen-to-one switch: a knob chooses which of sixteen input jacks reaches the output, carrying all of its polyphonic channels

params.text: Chooses which input reaches out, stepping through the numbers 0 to 15

inputs.text: One of sixteen inputs; it reaches out when the knob is set to its number, and a lamp beside it lights while it is the chosen one

outputs.text: Carries whatever is on the chosen input, with the same number of channels; it reads 0V on one channel while that input is unpatched

notes: the inputs are numbered 0 to 15, running 0 to 7 down the left column and 8 to 15 down the right, and the knob's number picks one of them
nothing is mixed or summed here: the fifteen inputs that are not chosen are read nowhere, and changing the knob cuts straight from one to the other with no crossfade
